column1: This project provides a searchable directory for South African auto repair businesses
column2: with a focus on specialist workshops for specific vehicle makes and repair categories. It contains:

column1: - ASP.NET Core MVC website with province/city filtering and specialist/general result sections.
- Shared domain model and ranking logic.
- Console scraper for importing CSV records and updating the same database.
- Automated xUnit tests for ranking and data integrity.
- Optional: SQLite DB browser for inspection
- or the local ASP.NET Core port displayed in the console
The application uses SQLite and stores the database at a path configured in `appsettings.json`.

The database is initialized automatically with `Database.EnsureCreated()` and seeding when the app starts. This is a reliable schema-initialisation approach that does not erase the database on each startup.
The app seeds the nine South African provinces
column3: and a small set of demonstration businesses labelled as demo data only.

column1: Weights and thresholds are configured in the same file and can be adjusted without changing the MVC controllers.
- Google and Facebook integrations are represented as extension points and documented as optional
- Public search remains supported even when optional live APIs are unavailable.
- No real API credentials are included in config files.
- This is a working MVP and not a fully expanded production directory.
- Optional paid-source integrations are implemented as interfaces and configuration-ready hooks rather than live API integrations without credentials.
- The initial data set is demonstration-oriented and intentionally not presented as verified real-world business data.
